project_type: Next.js 14 App Router full-stack (monorepo, single deploy on Vercel)
build_command: echo 'DATABASE_URL="postgresql://x:x@localhost:5432/x"' > .env && echo 'NEXTAUTH_SECRET="x"' >> .env && npx prisma generate && npx next build && rm -f .env
verification_instructions: Run the build command to verify documentation files don't break the build. Documentation is Markdown only so no compile step needed.
environment_constraints: Network access available. The task is documentation-only (Markdown/Mermaid files). No runtime dependencies needed.
contribution_requirements: Documentation goes in /projects/sandbox/incorporated/docs/ directory. Existing file: docs/SDD_Incorporated.md (SDD document already present).
key_patterns: The project uses: NextAuth.js v5 (Auth.js) with JWT strategy, Prisma ORM with Neon PostgreSQL, AI providers via Strategy Pattern (Gemini/Ollama/None), RBAC with role hierarchy (SUPER_ADMIN > ADMIN > DIRECTOR > JEFE_AREA > JEFE_PROYECTO > COLABORADOR > INDIVIDUAL), rate limiting, audit logging, document upload with text extraction (mammoth for Word, pdf-parse disabled), pattern-based and AI-powered document analysis.
directory_structure: src/app/(auth)/ - auth pages (login, registro), src/app/(dashboard)/ - protected pages (dashboard, objetivos, actividades, kpis, documentos, construir, asistente, admin, notificaciones, reportes), src/app/api/ - REST API routes (auth, ai, docs, actividades, kpis, dashboard, reportes, settings), src/lib/ - shared logic (auth, ai, db, security, services, utils), src/components/ - React components (admin, ai, dashboard, layout, ui), prisma/ - schema and seed, docs/ - documentation
